title: Signal profiles
description: The electrical interface of each part: which signals the MCU must provide, which rail it draws from, whether it carries its own pull-ups, and which simulator part represents it. Kept separate from parts_db.json (mechanical + price + sourcing) so both can evolve independently. The solver reads BOTH.

default_signals.description: What the MCU must provide for this part. NEVER a pin number -- the solver allocates. Empty is valid for a passive part (a level shifter needs no pins).

power_rail.description: 3v3 = the logic rail; 5v = VIN / the 5V rail; external = the part needs its own supply (servos, LED strips).

signal_multiplicity.description: per_unit: count multiplies the number of signals (six servos = six PWM pins). per_part: count multiplies the load but not the signals (one data line for a 30-LED strip).

wokwi_name.description: The Wokwi part name, or null if Wokwi has no equivalent. A part with null is excluded from the simulation and the plan says so in notes.

vision_aliases.description: Text prompts used to describe this part to a segmentation model.

keywords.description: Words a user might type, used by the offline fallback parser to map free text onto a part id.
